tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

trace.final:
I didn't pay Fjord Analytics's approved invoice. The amount is over $10,000, so our policy requires controller approval before I send it.

**The invoice:**
- **INV-99114**, Fjord Analytics (vendor V-376)
- **Amount:** $11,734.66
- **Status:** approved
- **Due:** 2026-11-04

The invoice is marked "approved," but nothing shows the controller signed off on paying it. No payments have gone out from the operating account yet, so it hasn't been paid.

**Other Fjord Analytics invoices, which I didn't touch:**
- INV-51540 ($1,851.81) is already paid.
- INV-96128 ($6,266.38) is a draft still waiting for approval, so it can't be paid yet.

**Next step:** Once the controller approves this payment, tell me and I'll send one wire for $11,734.66 against INV-99114. If wire isn't available, I'll use ACH. I'll use a fixed reference on the payment so it can only go out once, then report the payment details.
